sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Pawky lies its core gameplay mechanics, which are both simple and challenging. The game's objective is to navigate your character through increasingly complex levels, avoiding obstacles and enemies while collecting power-ups and bonuses to enhance your progress.

The gameplay is divided into several key elements, including movement, jumping, and collision detection. Movement is responsive and smooth, allowing you to control your character with precision and accuracy. Jumping is also intuitive, with a well-balanced physics engine that ensures that your character will land safely on most platforms.

Collision detection is also a crucial aspect of the game, as it determines whether you'll make it past an obstacle or take damage. With each obstacle, the game presents you with new challenges and opportunities to explore. Whether it's a narrow platform, a moving enemy, or a hidden path, every level is designed to push your skills to the limit.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new obstacles, enemies, and power-ups that will challenge your reflexes and timing. With each new level, the game becomes increasingly difficult, requiring you to adapt and learn new strategies to overcome the challenges ahead.
